name: Fidenza (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fidenza (a black eagle on yellow and a white cross on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Fidenza, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Fidenza arms — black eagle on yellow and a white cross on red, crowned, within branches
